notes.title: The game "Doll Grabber" is about to launch!
notes.notes:
Hello, players. We are very happy to announce that "Doll Grabber" will be coming soon!
This is a casual puzzle game that simulates a claw machine.
There are 30 cute dolls waiting for you to grab!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/e40ca53463678aff150d2ebfa3c7949cefcb8975.jpg[/img]

After finishing the game, you can experience various exquisite character illustrations as a reward!
In the DLC version, you can still find numerous character animations and clothing differences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/77c315232a96748ad2487badd55cc9a3fb0e6b54.jpg[/img]

Now each character has an independent short story,
And we are very happy to announce that this game also adds Japanese voiceovers for all characters,
You can hear the voices of various girls, with full voice-overs for all differences and animations!

Now you can experience the realistic performance of the role!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/16217413a8838de5a89a6245cc4bb5bef7f1a99b.gif[/img]

If you are interested in our game, please add it to your wish list,
This will be very helpful to us, thank you very much!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/9283985fb33d20316ff0e8089ba26c8065c07c7b.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2941350/_/

notes.title: The game "Monster Line of Defense" is about to go live!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! The long-awaited No.25 new release is finally going to meet everyone! "Monster Line of Defense" is a casual shooting game. Players need to control the turret in the screen by moving left and right, and click the left mouse button to shoot the oncoming monsters. When the monsters are not eliminated, they will pile up in front of the turret.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2373340/_/

You can switch between unique weapons to shoot the monsters in the game. The game difficulty is at a casual level, making it suitable for players who don't want to spend too much energy completing the game. The coins obtained in the game can be used to unlock more powerful weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40556717/1d2dbfe5082f2d2fc0e8c3b6cd1eb4212e7773ee.gif[/img]

"Monster Line of Defense" is expected to be launched in September. You can now add the game to your wishlist to receive the latest updates and news about the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40556717/82ddc987b1b520944b7e2e1ec014154813e3f029.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update May 5th
notes.notes: Updated the position of the fullscreen/windowed button in the settings. Now some players with special screen ratios can press the ESC key to bring up the settings panel during the game to adjust the game to windowed mode. (like a 5:4 or 4:3 screen)

notes.title: The early beta version of the game "Rolling in the Maze" is about to be released
notes.notes:
This is a casual game that controls a small ball to spin a maze. The game is easy and enjoyable~
The early access version is scheduled to be released in early April!

In "Rolling in the Maze", the player turns into a small ball to solve the maze. In order to reach the end, players need to crack according to the different level mechanisms of each level.

This is a casual ball maze game. There are currently 7 levels in the game, and the mechanics of each level are different. Press "A" and "D" on the keyboard to control the rotation of the maze, and the small balls in the maze will follow the gravity. move,
There are three stars in each level, let's solve the maze to the end.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899400/Rolling_in_the_Maze/
